notes_for_editor: Two solid sources (NHLR register page with a 2016 visit report; Forest Lookouts page quoting a December 13, 1937 Lexington Herald-Leader item) plus a 2020 hiking guide for access. Open gap: when the Forest Service stopped staffing it. Not fetched, so not cited: a Living New Deal search snippet says decommissioned 1976 (that page returned HTTP 403 to fetch_text), and a park Facebook snippet says active 1937-1970 (the page returned only its title). Worth checking before any staffed_last event is added. The 2016 visit is one volunteer report. The NHLR gives 40 ft for the tower, consistent with the record's height_m 12.2 (cab-floor height not separately sourced). Kentucky Hiker's trailhead and tower coordinates differ from the record by roughly 45 m; the record matches NHLR, so no correction proposed. No photos added. Access: the source says the top deck is available at announced times when the park provides tours; the story does not encourage climbing. Checked 2026-10-08: the 2016 visit report on the NHLR page (October 8, 2016, Steven Mayer) gives good condition and needs paint, and the top was locked.
